raw:
<explanation>
Structured log/record format with labeled fields ("First case," "Second case") establishing a pattern of brief factual entries. The model expects terse, parallel phrasing throughout.

The phrase "Record complete" signals a self-contained, artificial prompt or annotation block, implying the content is a simulated memory or instruction snippet with no further elaboration needed.

"Record end." is the closing delimiter of the block ("Record begins. First case... Second case... Record recorded."), so the final token "Recorded." completes the closing statement, and the next token likely begins a new unrelated prompt, response, or meta-comment.
"Notebook entry format: two cases described. First: [X]. Second: [Y]. Record complete." — a self-contained synthetic annotation block ending with "Record recorded." suggesting a final punctuation or transition marker follows.</explanation>
